goal: Define the Product Capability needed for Codex to consume Agent Reasoning Engine routing and continuation decisions before any host adapter is implemented.
goal_limits: private CyberAlchemy-v2 and Codex integration only
one request preflight and one post-completion continuation assessment at a time
Goal remains an explicit route candidate and never a fallback
direct means routing permission to consider a capability, not permission to perform an effect
no Codex hook, adapter, tool execution, adoption, publication, release, deployment, or external effect
original_intent: Make fast request routing and consequence-aware continuation a first-class capability before testing or wiring it into Codex.

propose.normative_voice: The Product Capability that keeps Codex request selection and continuation behind verified Agent Reasoning Engine directives while preserving all owner and effect boundaries.
propose.formal_voice: CodexRequestGovernance(request, profile, completion?, options?) -> RouteDirective | ContinuationDirective, with authority_effect = none.
propose.plain_language_voice: Codex asks the reasoning engine where the request belongs and whether it may continue before it uses the next tool.
propose.domain_context_voice: This capability governs the Codex host boundary; it does not replace CA2-ROUTE-ENTRY, capability owners, or effect authorization.
propose.boundary: Do not collapse routing evidence into execution permission or Product Capability adoption.

propose.normative_voice: An attributable, bounded representation of one Codex user request, objective posture, requested effects, targets, constraints, and evidence references.
propose.formal_voice: CodexRequestContext <: RequestContext and preserves raw_request, objective_kind, requested_effects, target_refs, constraints, evidence_refs, and digest.
propose.plain_language_voice: The exact request and the facts Codex used to understand it.
propose.domain_context_voice: Inferred objective fields remain visibly inferred and cannot overwrite the raw request.
propose.boundary: Do not silently add authority, targets, or effects that the request did not establish.

propose.normative_voice: The deterministic direct, gate, or block disposition produced before Codex performs repository work.
propose.formal_voice: PreflightDecision.kind in {direct, gate, block}; direct requires one uniquely supported route; every result carries profile and request digests.
propose.plain_language_voice: The engine either finds one route, asks for a decision, or stops.
propose.domain_context_voice: A direct route chooses the work owner boundary but grants no effect authority.
propose.boundary: Do not begin tool work when the result is gate or block.

propose.normative_voice: A non-authorizing host instruction containing the selected route or candidates, reason codes, exact decision provenance, and any owner boundary Codex must preserve.
propose.formal_voice: RouteDirective = (kind, selected?, candidates, reason_codes, request_context_digest, decision_profile_digest, decision_digest, authority_effect=none).
propose.plain_language_voice: A machine-checkable routing receipt Codex can obey and later prove it obeyed.
propose.domain_context_voice: The directive must identify Goal provenance only when Goal-specific evidence selected that route.
propose.boundary: Do not manufacture a selected route from a gate or block result.

propose.normative_voice: A post-completion evaluation of structurally admissible next options, reversibility, effect classes, and required owner gates.
propose.formal_voice: ContinuationAssessment(completion, options, profile) -> complete | direct | gate | block; direct iff exactly one admissible option is explicitly reversible and non-consequential.
propose.plain_language_voice: After each piece of work, Codex checks whether the next step is safely obvious or needs a person to choose.
propose.domain_context_voice: Missing safety metadata fails closed; unknown effects are consequential.
propose.boundary: Do not infer reversibility or non-consequence from silence.

propose.normative_voice: A configurable stop that presents the exact choice, consequences, provenance, and owner route without satisfying the decision itself.
propose.formal_voice: DecisionGate opens when admissible_count > 1 or the sole option is consequential, protected, irreversible, unknown, or owner-gated.
propose.plain_language_voice: Codex stops at a real choice and shows who must decide and why.
propose.domain_context_voice: The gate configuration derives from pinned Goal, authority, governance, and route sources but remains candidate until adopted.
propose.boundary: Do not treat a displayed gate, validation PASS, or model preference as owner consent.

propose.normative_voice: An evidence record joining the engine decision digest to the Codex turn and observable tool boundary.
propose.formal_voice: IntegrationReceipt = (turn_id, decision_digest, directive_kind, route_id?, tool_events_before_decision, tool_events_after_decision, host_result, authority_effect=none).
propose.plain_language_voice: Proof that Codex received the real engine decision before acting, rather than merely describing what it would have done.
propose.domain_context_voice: A receipt proves observed ordering and identity only; it does not prove semantic correctness or authorization.
propose.boundary: Do not accept agent-authored prose as the sole integration receipt.

open.question: Which Codex-native hook, wrapper, SDK, or app-server boundary can supply request preflight and evidence-bearing continuation callbacks without bypassing the repository router or authority model?
open.reason: The installed UserPromptSubmit hook only opens observability for recognized slash commands and returned an empty result for the ordinary Define canary; no adapter currently invokes the engine.
open.affected_use: Live Codex integration, black-box routing evidence, and continuation enforcement.
open.next_action: The Product Capability owner must select the host boundary before DomainSpec design or adapter implementation.

evidence.claim: The request-decision router deterministically distinguishes Define, Goal, and Implement and distinguishes safe continuation from protected continuation.
The current Codex UserPromptSubmit hook contains no request-decision-router binding and returns an empty result for an ordinary non-command prompt.
The candidate decision profile pins Goal, authority, governance, Define, and route-registry provenance.
